## How engagements work

Every engagement on this page is **fixed-scope and fixed-price**. No
hourly drip; no scope creep; no surprises on the invoice. The starting
move on any new engagement is a 30-minute discovery call — free, no
obligation. After that, if there is a fit, I send a one-page proposal
with deliverable, timeline and price. You decide, sign, and we begin.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
**Not sure which service fits?**
The fastest path is to [book a 30-minute discovery call](#discovery-call)
below. I will tell you which offer is right (or that none of them is and
you need a different specialist — I am not the right answer for every
problem).
:::

## What I don't take on

To save us both time:

- Work that conflicts with my current role at Basra Energy Company
  Limited (BP / CNPC JV). I keep a strict conflict-of-interest framework
  and will decline anything that touches it.
- Work that requires me to use any prior-employer proprietary data,
  contractor performance information, or confidential figures.
- Generic data-science work outside wells engineering. I am a wells
  authority who has learned data, not a generalist data scientist.
- Large open-ended retainers. Every service on this page is sized to
  deliver something concrete in 5–30 days.

## Discovery call {#discovery-call}

Thirty minutes. I will tell you what I can help with, what I cannot, and
what a useful next step looks like. No obligation.

Mattey Energy Ltd is the UK-registered consulting vehicle through which
